descriptions.notStarted: I should go see Moppie, who seemed tired and weary of waiting for his master.
descriptions.inProgress: I saw Moppie in Orbis, and he seemed unresponsive to my commands. You could tell he's been waiting for his master for a long time judging from the wrinkly, dirty, unruly hair he features. I wanted to help him out, but I cannot understand whatever Moppie is uttering. I need someone as a translator so I can talk to him, but ... should I ask for a person, or a fairy?
descriptions.completed: I had no idea what Moppie was saying, so I got to ask Lisa for some help.
